implementation.entry: - **Madhusudan Pati — *Kalindi Charan Panigrahi*.** Published by Sahitya Akademi in 2001, this literary biography leads from *Matira Manisha* into [the writer’s working life](../../people/kalindi-charan-panigrahi.md). In selected sample pages, Pati describes a handwritten magazine carrying Odia, Bengali and English writing under Kalindi’s editorship. He also follows memoir instalments for *Kalana* into an enlarged autobiography. Magazine-making and recollection offer two ways to approach the person behind the film’s story credit.[^monograph]
implementation.note: [^monograph]: Madhusudan Pati, *Kalindi Charan Panigrahi*: [Sahitya Akademi catalogue](https://sahitya-akademi.gov.in/publications/english.pdf), 2001; [public samples](https://www.exoticindiaart.com/book/details/kalindi-charan-panigrahi-makers-of-indian-literature-old-and-rare-book-hay299/), printed pp. 7, 25, 65.
